facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 14 to 29 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Moss Springs

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 5 and May 19, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Moss Springs
